other_failure_modes.name: Cross-validation leakage
other_failure_modes.description: Global transformations (like scaling or mean imputation) are applied to the entire training set before the cross-validation split. This leaks information from the validation folds into the training folds, rendering the validation scores overly optimistic.

other_failure_modes.name: Selecting best CV fold model for test predictions
other_failure_modes.description: Instead of ensembling the models from all cross-validation folds or retraining a new model on the full training set, the agent simply selects the single model that performed best on its specific validation fold. This leads to overfitting on that particular validation subset.

summary: The agent implements a LightGBM regression pipeline with 5-fold cross-validation, but falls into several bad practices. While it correctly avoids leaking the external test set, it introduces data leakage during cross-validation by scaling and imputing before the internal fold splits. Furthermore, instead of ensembling or retraining, it wrongly selects the single 'best' fold model for its final test predictions, which risks overfitting to a specific validation subset.
